results.title: KCD Porto 2026 | Collab with DevOps Days Portugal
results.description_short: KCD Porto 2026 returns bigger than ever, alongside DevOps Days Portugal! Expect keynotes, technical talks and networking with 500+ attendees from the cloud-native community. The agenda is locked: 65+ speakers across 50+ talks, keynotes and invited sessions. Sponsorships are still open but close on October 16. Tickets are flying and we're down to the last 100, so grab yours before they're gone!

chapter.description: The Kubernetes and Cloud Native community will gather again in Porto for KCD Porto 2025—the only Kubernetes Community Days event in Iberia in 2025. Built by the community, for the community, it brings together developers, platform engineers, and cloud specialists for two days of inspiring talks and networking. As the largest CNCF event in Portugal, it's the place to connect, learn, and shape the future of cloud-native. This community event is supported by the CNCF, together with xgeeks
chapter.title: KCD Porto

results.description_short: Cloud Native Suisse Romande will be hosting its second KCD on 09-10 December 2026 at CERN. Join us for multiple local community talks in English and French!

chapter.description: Our association aims to connect end users, contributors, and maintainers of cloud-native computing projects in the Suisse Romande region. Kubernetes Community Days is a way to do it, so see you in December 2026 for the second edition!

results.title: KCD Provence 2026
results.description_short:
Kubernetes Community Days Provence 2026 
🇫🇷Plongez au cœur de l’innovation Cloud Native Rejoignez-nous pour une journée dédiée au technologie AI et CloudNative .

chapter.description:
KCD Provence est une conférence communautaire qui rassemble développeurs, plateform engineers et professionnels IT passionnés par les technologies Cloud Native. Organisé par l'association Cloud Native Provence, cet événement s'inscrit dans le réseau mondial des Kubernetes Community Days soutenu par la CNCF.

Pendant une journée, vous profiterez de talks inspirants donnés par des experts, d'ateliers pratiques pour approfondir vos compétences, d'un espace exposition pour découvrir les acteurs de l'écosystème, et de nombreux moments d'échange dans un cadre exceptionnel.
chapter.title: KCD Provence
